verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official CLI for use from the terminal, coding agents, local scripts, and CI/CD pipelines. It has a browser-based login that stores a token locally, and it handles artifact processing and upload (sourcemaps, dSYM, etc.). missing for 10: documentation of the CLI's broader command surface beyond auth and artifact upload, agent-specific features such as structured/JSON output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The PostHog CLI lets you use PostHog from your terminal, your coding agents, local scripts, and CI/CD pipelines.
This opens a browser-based login flow, stores a personal API token locally, and reuses it for CLI commands.
Skip artifact processing and upload (sourcemap, dSYM, hermes, proguard) without contacting PostHog or requiring credentials.
